more_info.overview: Polyvinylpyrrolidone, or PVP, is a polymer of N-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone supplied in molecular-weight grades. Its stabilising role is to help a food maintain its physical consistency or the distribution of its ingredients. The specified material is supplied as white powder. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain food supplements supplied in a solid form, excluding food supplements for infants and young children; table-top sweeteners in tablets; foods for special medical purposes as defined by Regulation No 609/2013.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
